sd: microSD over SPI. CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_SDMMC, FATFS (ELM) with exFAT enabled. Mount is FS_FATFS.
policy: Owner's standing rule: audio is written to SD ONLY when a chunk upload cannot be uploaded. It is a failure buffer, not a routine store.
note: exFAT means large files and long filenames are available.
status: PROTOTYPE. This is a Nordic development kit, not the product. Every choice here — the SoC, the RAM, the single button, the single LED, the enclosure — is provisional and can change. Design the device the owner should wear, then say what it would take to build it.
you_are_here: You run on a Cloudflare Worker. The pendant and ESP32 below are REMOTE devices you talk to over the network; you are not running on them.
